title: Harbour at sunset
note: A small fishing harbour at sunset: moored wooden boats, a stone quay with houses, an orange and rose sky breaking into violet clouds, the water laid on with a knife. Oil on a warm toned canvas. Written by paintings/harbour.gen.mjs.

sienna canvas.note: a canvas toned with a warm burnt-sienna imprimatura

evening raking.note: a low lamp from the upper left, a little softer on the highlights

thin.note: paint thinned with turpentine for the lay-in

sky.note: buttery oil that stays open and blends with what it is laid into

wall.note: paint for the walls: smoother, so the brush marks do not read as weave

dark.note: dark oil with body and gloss, so that its relief still reads

impasto.note: stiff paint straight from the tube for the lights

clean.note: a clean touch that does not sink into what is wet beneath

line.note: thin dark paint for rigging and ropes

cloud.note: a worn filbert pressed nearly flat: broad strokes with rounded, ragged ends

scumble.note: a nearly dry brush dragged over the tooth

slab.note: a knife laid flat and pulled sideways: a thin slab with a soft lip and ragged ends

pole.note: a round pressed evenly, for masts

steps.name: Drawing
steps.note: The main lines drawn with a small brush in thin violet-brown: horizon, quay, houses, hulls and masts.

steps.name: Block-in
steps.note: Thin colour scrubbed into the masses: the houses, roofs, quay and hulls, darker than they will end.

steps.name: Sky
steps.note: Broad strokes of buttery paint, violet above to orange and gold at the horizon, curving round the sun; laid wet so they blend.

steps.name: Clouds
steps.note: The violet cloud masses worked into the wet sky, their undersides warmed where the sun reaches them.

steps.name: Sky lights
steps.note: Thick paint for the sun, the glow round it and the lit edges of the clouds.

steps.name: Far shore
steps.note: The low headland across the harbour mouth in hazy violet, the breakwater dark against the glow, and its light.

steps.name: Water
steps.note: Horizontal strokes, each the colour of what the water mirrors at that place, getting bigger toward the viewer.

steps.name: Knife reflections
steps.note: The palette knife drawn across the dry water in short horizontal slabs: reflected sky, the dark of the boats and the quay.

steps.name: Glitter
steps.note: The sun's path on the water in thick pale paint, and sparks across the ripples; the last touches of light.

steps.name: Quay
steps.note: The stone wall in shadow, coursed and jointed, warm with light thrown up from the water; wet and weedy low down; the paving on top.

steps.name: Houses
steps.note: Tall narrow houses along the quay, painted far to near; their fronts in shadow against the sun, warm and violet; the tower behind.

steps.name: House lights
steps.note: The low sun along the edges turned to it, in thick paint: the right-hand verges and corners, ridges, the tops of the walls.

steps.name: Boats
steps.note: The boats far to near: planked hulls in shadow, warm decks, the sun along the gunwales; masts, furled sails and rigging.

steps.name: Moorings
steps.note: Mooring lines from the bollards to the boats, sagging; small dark accents at the waterlines.
